Title: Authenticated user lands on a working home page
Steps: 1. Navigate to app 2. App auto-redirects using saved session
Expected Result: User is not redirected to login and home page renders

Title: User can log in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Enter valid username/password 3. Submit
Expected Result: User is redirected away from the login page into the app

Title: Invalid credentials show inline error
Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Enter invalid credentials 3. Submit
Expected Result: Inline error message is shown; user remains on login page

Title: Empty submission blocked client-side
Steps: 1. Go to login page 2. Click Sign in without entering data
Expected Result: User remains on login page; no crash

Title: Password reset email is sent for a known account
Steps: 1. Click 'Forgot password' 2. Enter registered email 3. Submit
Expected Result: Confirmation message shown; reset email received within 5 minutes

Title: Session expires after configured inactivity window
Steps: 1. Log in 2. Remain idle past session timeout 3. Attempt an action
Expected Result: User is prompted to re-authenticate

Title: Home page loads with dashboard cards
Steps: 1. Load home page
Expected Result: Dashboard grid renders without error

Title: Search returns and opens a known dashboard
Steps: 1. Search dashboard by name 2. Click result
Expected Result: Dashboard opens and displays its cards

Title: Search for nonexistent dashboard returns no results
Steps: 1. Search for a made-up dashboard name
Expected Result: No matching results are shown

Title: Applying a dashboard filter updates visible data
Steps: 1. Open dashboard 2. Apply filter value
Expected Result: Cards refresh and reflect filtered data

Title: Dashboard renders correctly on tablet viewport
Steps: 1. Resize to tablet viewport 2. Open dashboard
Expected Result: Layout reflows without overlapping elements

Title: Analyst can create run and save a new report
Preconditions: Authenticated session; at least one data source
Steps: 1. New > Question 2. Pick table 3. Run query 4. Save with a name
Expected Result: Report is saved and appears by name in the app

Title: Running a query without a data source is blocked
Steps: 1. New > Question 2. Do not select a table 3. Attempt to run
Expected Result: Run/Get Answer button is disabled

Title: Result row count is stable across a page refresh
Steps: 1. Run a query 2. Note row count 3. Refresh page
Expected Result: Row count after refresh matches the original

Title: Report can be duplicated and edited independently
Steps: 1. Open saved report 2. Duplicate 3. Edit the copy
Expected Result: Original report is unchanged; copy reflects edits

Title: Adding a filter narrows the result set
Steps: 1. Run base query 2. Add filter 3. Apply
Expected Result: Row count decreases or stays equal; never increases

Title: Clearing a filter restores original result count
Steps: 1. Remove filter chip
Expected Result: Row count returns to the pre-filter value

Title: Combining two filters applies AND logic
Steps: 1. Apply filter A 2. Apply filter B
Expected Result: Only rows matching both conditions are shown

Title: Exporting results as CSV downloads a file
Steps: 1. Click download 2. Choose .csv
Expected Result: A .csv file download is triggered with matching row data

Title: Exporting results as PDF downloads a file
Steps: 1. Click download 2. Choose .pdf
Expected Result: A .pdf file download is triggered

Title: Export menu can be dismissed without downloading
Steps: 1. Open export menu 2. Press Escape
Expected Result: Menu closes; no download occurs

Title: Exported CSV values match on-screen totals
Steps: 1. Note on-screen total 2. Export CSV 3. Open file
Expected Result: Values in the file match the UI exactly

Title: QA can create a new collection
Steps: 1. Open Collections 2. New collection 3. Name it 4. Create
Expected Result: Collection is created and visible in the list

Title: Archiving a report removes it from the active list
Preconditions: At least one saved report exists
Steps: 1. Open Collections 2. Archive an item
Expected Result: Item no longer appears in the active list

Title: Archived reports can be restored
Steps: 1. Open Archive 2. Restore item
Expected Result: Item reappears in its original collection

Title: Role-restricted user cannot access admin settings
Steps: 1. Log in as non-admin 2. Navigate to /admin
Expected Result: Access is denied or option is not shown in navigation
